known_limitations: The page colour is the cover's dominant accent blended into the theme background, not the colour of its lower edge.
A greyscale cover gives no colour: the page keeps its plain background.
In the whole-cover mode the sharp cover sits on its blurred copy with straight edges.
A Canvas is cropped to the header like a cover; it is never letterboxed.
The tint is off when the album colours setting is off.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
